$doc: Tier manifest for scripts/run-verifies.mjs. Tiers: pure = hermetic Node/tsx (no external network, no dev server, no real ~/FluxLib mutation — a script that writes to FluxLib redirects HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME into a scratch dir before flux-core loads AND passes an explicit libPath; verify-hermetic-fluxlib.ts enforces the libPath half) — this is the `npm test` gate; net = hits external APIs (opt-in); ui = curated stable browser suite against the dev server on :1420 (runner spawns one if absent); ui-extra = the full browser sweep (slow; pre-release / polish audits); bundle+startup = need `npm run build` first; electron = need a real Electron run (manual). Groups name cross-tier sets (paper-gate = the paper editor regression suite). New verify scripts MUST be added here to join the gate. presence = the source-shape/regex subset (main-process + build config that headless drivers cannot exercise); these scripts ALSO live in pure (their gate home) — the tier exists for pathMap's electron/** mapping. Execution metadata is authoritative and independent of selectors. Every attempt receives scratch HOME/config/cache/library; blocked and flaky are not passes. Native no-sandbox is explicit test-only FLUX_ELECTRON_NO_SANDBOX=1. Network tests require FLUX_ALLOW_TEST_NETWORK=1.
$pathMap-doc: WS-7.6b: `run-verifies.mjs --changed` maps `git diff` files through these ORDERED entries (first glob match wins per file; matched `run` sets union; any unmatched file falls back to tier:pure). `self` = a changed verify script runs itself. tier:presence and tier:scale entries activate as those tiers land (unknown names warn + skip).

pathMap.$comment: verify-extension-build.ts covers the same sources but reads extension/dist, so it needs `npm run build` first and is deliberately NOT listed here — a --changed sweep must not demand a build the caller never asked for. CI runs it in the bundle tier, after the build.
